scientific_integrity: Proof uses known single-polarization stability with attribution; symbolic finite checks only supplement the infinite mathematical argument.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers for complete linear series of positive bidegree on the product of two projective lines; Gieseker stability, other surfaces and incomplete series are not addressed. Central-polarization stability is cited from Torres-López and Zamora (arXiv:2008.11255); exact historical priority is not independently verified.
title: Exact slope-stability chambers and Harder–Narasimhan filtrations for Segre–Veronese syzygy bundles
